item.title: Improving site performance by shipping more CSS
item.description: How we fully migrated github.com away from CSS-in-JS. The post Improving site performance by shipping more CSS appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (2 sources: githubblog, lobsters)

item.title: Valve Introduces Pyrowave Video Codec In Beta For Low Latency Streaming
item.description: Valve's Steam client beta today introduced Pyrowave as an experimental video codec for high bandwidth, low-latency video streaming. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: GKE Pod Snapshots Cut Model Load Times, and Move the Work to Snapshot Lifecycle Management
item.description: Google has published benchmarks for GKE Pod snapshots, reporting up to 89% lower startup latency and a 70B model loading in 37 seconds. The feature checkpoints CPU and GPU memory through gVisor into Cloud Storage. (1 source: infoq)
